name: INEGI · ENOE
authority: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
coverage: person-level microdata joined to dwelling/household tables; derived slice grain is field_of_study x country x quarter x metric
population: Usual residents of selected dwellings; economic characteristics are collected for ages 12+, while published indicators are generated for ages 15+.

name: Observatorio Laboral · STPS
authority: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social (STPS)
coverage: career or study area at national level
population: The glossary defines career statistics over occupied persons with higher education; exact filters must be confirmed per indicator.
periodicity: Page reported figures updated to 2026-Q2 during audit.

name: Data México · Secretaría de Economía
coverage: Varies by cube, drilldown, measure and cut.
population: Varies by cube and originating source.
periodicity: Varies by dataset; version 5.1.0 dated 2025-11-25 reports updated ENOE employment data.

name: IMCO · Compara Carreras
population: Usual residents ages 15-98 with complete interview; professional-degree or postgraduate completers for bachelor's indicators and technical-degree completers for TSU.
periodicity: Edition based on the four most recent quarters; 2026 uses 2025-Q2 through 2026-Q1.

name: INEGI · MOPRADEF
authority: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
population: Ver nota metodológica y ruptura de población
